ArgonTest.Name: Erased method value
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::*
proc printMessage(erased n: Int): () = puts "Hello World"
trait MyTrait public erased def self.erasedFunc(a: Int)(b: Int): Int = a + b public erased def self.erasedFunc2(a: Int)(b: Int): Int = self.erasedFunc 1 2 end
instance MyInst: MyTrait end
proc main(): () do let o = MyInst printMessage(o.erasedFunc2 1 2) end
